clear_cache: Clear the local email and analytics cache for this Proton Mail account.
delete_email: Permanently delete an email from Proton Mail.
get_connection_status: Check whether the Proton Mail SMTP and IMAP (Proton Bridge) connections are currently working.
get_contacts: List Proton Mail contacts, with how often you've emailed each one.
get_email_analytics: Get advanced analytics on Proton Mail email activity: senders, patterns, trends over time.
get_email_stats: Get summary statistics about the Proton Mail mailbox: counts of emails, unread, by folder.
get_logs: Get recent Proton Mail MCP server logs for troubleshooting sync or connection issues.
get_volume_trends: Get email volume over time (sent/received counts per day/week) for Proton Mail.
mark_email_read: Mark a Proton Mail email as read or unread.
send_test_email: Send a test email through Proton Mail to verify the SMTP connection works.
star_email: Star or unstar (flag) an email in Proton Mail.
sync_emails: Manually trigger a sync of emails from the Proton Mail server into the local cache.
sync_folders: Manually sync the Proton Mail folder/label structure from the server.
